headline: Sabres’ Ryan McLeod, Louis Crevier healthy scratches Friday against Columbus
take:
Daily Faceoff reported Ryan McLeod and Louis Crevier as healthy scratches for Friday against Columbus, with Jiri Kulich and Conor Timmins coming in.

McLeod's case is more bad luck than bad play. He has one goal and three points in 15 games after 54 points last season, but his on-ice luck reads -8.59: the Sabres have scored about eight and a half fewer goals with him out there than their chances earned. He's still one of the fastest skaters in the league, 98th percentile for top speed.

Crevier is harder to defend: Buffalo has taken 40.08% of the expected goals with him on at 5-on-5, 12.84 points worse than without him. Kulich (56.8% and +8.04 relative in nine games) has earned the look. McLeod's numbers argue for a quick return; Crevier's argue for patience.
